title: Mini-case: a discounter's coffee capsules
text: A discount retailer launches cheap compatible coffee capsules for a market leader's machines at 40 % lower prices. The leader sells capsules mainly through its own boutiques and website and earns most of its profit on capsules.

title: Mini-case: two electric-ferry projects
text: Two shipyards consider being first to launch electric passenger ferries: a slow-cycle market with 30-year ship lives, high certification costs and few customers (public transport authorities). A third firm considers launching the first AI tutoring app for school pupils, a market where new apps appear every month.

title: Mini-case: smartphone price-quality moves
text: A Chinese smartphone maker offers the camera quality of premium phones at mid-range prices. A year later, a mid-range brand cuts prices by 20 % at constant quality.
